column1: # THE ground vocabulary of the subworld. One row per TerrainMaterial id
# (sub/material.h) — the ordinal IS the id the material texture carries
# rows are append-only and never reordered.
# Lines starting with '#' are comments; tools/gen_ground_table.py and
# ground_table_test both skip them.
# family      — which procedural shape the ground wears (soil / turf / sand /
#               furrow / stone / track / mud). A family is a SHAPE
#               material: several materials share one and differ by numbers.
# albedo_*    — mean linear colour of the unlit ground.
# cv          — target coefficient of variation of luminance (lum_std / mean
#               linear). This is the ONE knob for "how blotchy": the generator
#               turns it into the lognormal sigma that reproduces it exactly
#               so the number stays comparable across materials instead of
#               being a per-material taste. Authored here
#               measured set of the reference project (smooth concrete 0.08
#               bare soil 0.22
# macro_cv    — the same coefficient of variation
#               patchwork (tens of metres): how blotchy the ground looks from
#               a hillside
